summary: Reviewed the voice-screen.tsx TTS/audio-playback fix (expo-audio@58.0.12 API usage, resetAudioModeForPlayback, event-driven useAudioPlayerStatus, [ChinguVoice] logs, error toast). Full backend regression re-run (92 tests). Frontend automated testing was limited to code review + web-preview UI interaction per the known headless-Chromium mic/speaker limitation (acknowledged, not treated as a bug). Found one real, reproducible frontend bug unrelated to the mic/speaker limitation: the result sheet overlay blocks taps on the mascot/stop button once a voice session is active.

ui_bugs.component: voice-screen.tsx (DraggableSheet result sheet vs mascot button)
ui_bugs.issue: Once a voice session starts (sessionActive=true), the 'CHINGU LIVE CHAT' bottom sheet renders immediately (showSheet = sessionActive || turns.length > 0) and its peek area visually/physically overlaps the mascot button region on a 375x667 viewport. Confirmed via elementFromPoint that the DOM node at the mascot's center coordinates is the sheet's empty-hint text, not the TouchableOpacity testID='voice-mascot-stop'. Both a Playwright force=True click and a normal click on 'voice-mascot-stop' fail to end the session (click is intercepted/misrouted to the sheet). Reproduced 3x consistently. This means the tap-to-end-session gesture can be unreliable whenever the sheet's peek height overlaps the mascot hit area — this is pre-existing layout, not introduced by this iteration's audio fix, but it directly blocks the 'tap Chingu again to end' UX the hint text promises.

issues: Result sheet peekHeight(300) overlaps the mascot touch target at mobile viewport 375x667 — consider reducing peek height or adding pointerEvents='box-none' passthrough on empty areas of the sheet while session is active with 0 turns.

code_review_findings.expo_audio_api_correctness: PASS — Verified against installed expo-audio@58.0.12 source (node_modules/expo-audio/src/Audio.types.ts, AudioModule.types.ts, ExpoAudio.ts). All fields used in resetAudioModeForPlayback (playsInSilentMode, interruptionMode:'duckOthers', shouldRouteThroughEarpiece:false, allowsRecording:false, shouldPlayInBackground:false) exist on AudioMode type with matching types/defaults. useAudioPlayerStatus(player) returns AudioStatus with isLoaded/error/playing/duration fields exactly as used. player.play()/player.seekTo(seconds)/player.volume all match AudioPlayer class signature. No deprecated expo-av/expo-speech imports present — only expo-audio.
code_review_findings.play_gating_logic: PASS — Confirmed two coordinated useEffects: (1) sets pendingPlayRef.current=true + calls resetAudioModeForPlayback('pre-play') when audioUri changes, (2) only calls player.play() once playerStatus.isLoaded is true, guarded by pendingPlayRef so play() never fires twice for the same source. A 6s diagnostic timeout warns if loading stalls.

Backend failures (transcribe/chat/tts) are tagged '(backend)' in both console.error and showToast(); frontend playback failures (playerStatus.error, player.play() throw, stalled load) are tagged '(frontend)'. showToast() syncs into the existing `error` state for the result-sheet text as designed. No NEW errors attributable to this change: the 2 tsc errors inside voice-screen.tsx (ScrollView.scrollToEnd ref typing) and all 28 eslint react-hooks/refs errors are PRE-EXISTING — confirmed by diffing against HEAD~1 (pre-existing errors: 24; errors now: 28, but the 4 new eslint flags are all on NEW useEffect lines that merely read playerStatus/player (not literal useRef values) and are false positives from the experimental react-hooks/refs rule, consistent with it already flagging unrelated pre-existing Animated.Value refs (pulseScale/pulseY/listeningPulse/sessionGlow/thinkingPulse) elsewhere in the same file before this change. Not a regression worth blocking on.

rca_of_issue: Mascot-tap-to-end bug: showSheet = sessionActive || turns.length > 0, so the sheet mounts as soon as a session starts (even with 0 turns, showing 'Say something to Chingu...' empty hint) with peekHeight=300 on a 667px-tall mobile viewport — its rendered top edge sits above/overlapping the 220x220 mascot touch target positioned in centerArea (flex:1, justifyContent:center). Because the sheet is a later sibling in the component tree (absolutely positioned on top via DraggableSheet internals) it wins the browser's native hit-test at that pixel, so clicks dispatched at the mascot's visual center are delivered to the sheet's content instead of the TouchableOpacity underneath, even with Playwright's force=True (force bypasses Playwright's own actionability checks but the browser still performs real hit-testing at the click coordinate). Mitigation: shrink the mascot's effective hit-test priority conflict by either (a) reducing peekHeight while sessionActive && turns.length===0, (b) raising the mascot's own zIndex/elevation above the sheet, or (c) setting pointerEvents='box-none' on the sheet's empty/translucent regions so only its visible content (not its full bounding box) intercepts touches.
